historicalDisclaimer: These are modern field recordings / sound effects, repurposed for a fictional game. They are not 1960s Kowloon–Canton Railway archival recordings. No modern public-address announcements or door chimes were intentionally added. Exact absence of incidental modern sounds has not been subjectively audited.

assets.title: Hiss of steam train #6 (description: steam locomotive whistle)
assets.author: Joseph SARDIN
assets.description: Real steam locomotive whistle recorded at Martel, France. Despite the English page title, this is listed as a whistle / TRNHorn, not a steam drain hiss.
assets.edits: Unmodified MP3; runtime playback rate 1.08 and gain adjustment.
assets.verification: Source page read; license, author and public download URL checked; actual bytes downloaded and ffmpeg decoded. No subjective listening test performed.

assets.title: single steam train chuff
assets.author: birdOfTheNorth; original field recording by keithpeter
assets.description: A single steam engine chuff extracted and cleaned from a field recording. Upstream original https://freesound.org/people/keithpeter/sounds/125211/ also CC0.
assets.edits: Public high-quality MP3 preview. Mono downmix, short fades, peak limiting, MP3 re-encode. Repeated by quarter-wheel rotations, runtime pitch and gain change.
assets.verification: Source page read; license, author and public download URL checked; actual bytes downloaded and ffmpeg decoded. No subjective listening test performed.

assets.title: Steam release sounds — Marker #1
assets.author: bart
assets.description: Steam hiss sound-effect pack. Recording technique is not documented; this is not claimed to be a real locomotive drain valve.
assets.edits: Selected Marker #1 WAV. Mono downmix, 100 Hz high-pass, 3.8 kHz low-pass, fades, peak limiting, MP3 encode; runtime slowed to 0.78.
assets.verification: Source page read; license, author and public download URL checked; actual bytes downloaded and ffmpeg decoded. No subjective listening test performed.

assets.title: train-braking.wav
assets.author: Radio_fragola_gorizia
assets.description: Train braking recorded with Zoom H4n in Gorizia, Italy. Modern field recording used as a metal brake texture, not historical KCR audio.
assets.edits: Public high-quality MP3 preview. Crop 7–12 s, mono, 600 Hz high-pass, 4 kHz low-pass, fades, peak limiting, MP3 encode. Runtime quiet loop while braking.
assets.verification: Source page read; license, author and public download URL checked; actual bytes downloaded and ffmpeg decoded. No subjective listening test performed.

assets.title: Chinese speaking crowd
assets.author: Lenguaverde
assets.description: Mandarin-speaking crowd in Beijing Jingshan Park. Modern ambiance is used at low level for the fictional game; not a Cantonese/Hong Kong or railway archive.
assets.edits: Public high-quality MP3 preview. Crop 8–32 s, mono, 140 Hz high-pass, 2.2 kHz low-pass, fades, peak limiting, MP3 encode. Played softly only near stations.
assets.verification: Source page read; license, author and public download URL checked; actual bytes downloaded and ffmpeg decoded. No subjective listening test performed.

originalSynthesis.content: Paired filtered noise / sine impulses generated in audio.mjs at 12.5 m rail-joint crossings.
Original short sine-based whistle cue generated in audio.mjs; no spoken station staff recording.
Original oscillator / filtered-noise synthesis used only if the matching sample is unavailable.

knownGaps: No verified licensed Cantonese station-staff shouted call was found in this pass. No fake historical voice was inserted.
Subjective listening and final in-game loudness QA remain to be performed.
